Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# Workflow derived from https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2/examples
# Need help debugging build failures? Start at https://github.com/r-lib/actions#where-to-find-help
#
# NOTE: This workflow is overkill for most R packages and
# check-standard.yaml is likely a better choice.
# usethis::use_github_action("check-standard") will install it.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      extra-packages:
        description: 'extra package to install for the runs (like a dev version of one of the deps) - comma separated'
        required: false
        type: string

name: R-CMD-check

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  R-CMD-check:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.config.os }}

    name: ${{ matrix.config.os }} (${{ matrix.config.r }})${{ github.event.inputs.extra-packages && ' - with some extra packages'|| ''}}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        config:
          - {os: windows-latest, r: 'release'}
          - {os: macOS-latest,   r: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,  r: 'devel', http-user-agent: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,  r: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,  r: 'oldrel-1'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,  r: 'oldrel-2'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,  r: 'oldrel-3'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,  r: 'oldrel-4'}

    env:
      DISPLAY: ':99.0'
      RGL_USE_NULL: TRUE
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      R_KEEP_PKG_SOURCE: yes
      _R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2.14.0
        with:
          r-version: ${{ matrix.config.r }}
          http-user-agent: ${{ matrix.config.http-user-agent }}
          use-public-rspm: true

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-tinytex@v2.14.0
        env:
          # install full prebuilt version
          TINYTEX_INSTALLER: TinyTeX

      - uses: yihui/actions/setup-r-dependencies@HEAD
        with:
          extra-packages: >
            ${{ (runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.config.r == 'release') && 'covr xml2' || '' }}
            ${{ github.event.inputs.extra-packages }}

      - uses: yihui/actions/check-r-package@HEAD

      - name: Test coverage
        if: success() && runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.config.r == 'release'
        run: |
          cov = covr::package_coverage(
            quiet = FALSE,
            clean = FALSE,
            install_path = file.path(normalizePath(Sys.getenv("RUNNER_TEMP"), winslash = "/"), "package")
          )
          covr::to_cobertura(cov)
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@HEAD
        if: success() && runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.config.r == 'release'
        with:
          fail_ci_if_error: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./cobertura.xml
          plugins: noop
          disable_search: true
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
